title: llm-d 1.0 Advances Open, Cost-Efficient AI Inference for Production Scale
hook_text: IBM and Red Hat just launched llm-d 1.0.
script:
IBM and Red Hat just launched llm-d 1.0, an open-source framework for AI inference.
Google, CoreWeave, and NVIDIA helped build this framework to manage production scale.
It tackles the soaring costs of running heavy AI workloads in enterprise systems.
The software optimizes how data flows through your infrastructure during inference.
This version removes traditional bottlenecks that limit large-scale AI deployment.
Will your infrastructure team integrate llm-d 1.0 into your production stack?
